tables.name: Housing
tables.description: Rolled for each district: how many people live there. Without housing in any district, people live in the city's general area.

results.name: None
results.description: No one lives in this district. (Rerolled for Slums and Upper Class districts.)

results.name: Limited
results.description: Only a few live here; the district may be predominantly a place of business or functionality, or perhaps people avoid living here for another, less innocent reason.

results.name: Moderate
results.description: A fair amount of the buildings in the district house residents.

results.name: Extensive
results.description: A significant amount of the district’s buildings are housing for residents.
